Package edu.scu.phantommaze.model

Class Player

java.lang.Object
edu.scu.phantommaze.model.Player
public class Player extends Object
The player: position, facing, and camera plane, with wall-sliding movement. Input is expressed as intents (-1..1) set by the controller before each update.

  • Constructor Details

    • Player

      public Player(Vector2 start, double angle)
      Creates a player.
      Parameters:
      start - the starting position in tile coordinates
      angle - the initial facing angle in radians (0 = east, positive turns clockwise on screen)

  • Method Details

    • setIntents

      public void setIntents(double forward, double strafe, double turn)
      Sets the current movement intents.
      Parameters:
      forward - -1 (back) to 1 (forward)
      strafe - -1 (left) to 1 (right)
      turn - -1 (turn left) to 1 (turn right)

    • rotate

      public void rotate(double radians)
      Turns the player instantly (used by the mouse).

      public void respawn(Vector2 start, double angle)

    • getMoveIntensity

      public double getMoveIntensity()
      How hard the movement keys are pushed, used to bob the weapon while walking.

    • update

      public void update(double dt, GameMap map, double speedMultiplier)
      Advances the player by one time step, turning and moving with collision.
      Parameters:
      dt - seconds elapsed
      map - the map to collide with
      speedMultiplier - 1 for normal speed, higher during the power-up

    • move

      public void move(double dx, double dy, GameMap map)
      Moves by a displacement, resolving each axis separately so the player slides along walls instead of sticking to them.

      dy - displacement along y
      map - the map to collide with
